name: Caltech-256 Object Category Dataset
description: Caltech-256 is an image classification and object recognition benchmark comprising 30,607 images across 256 distinct semantic object categories plus a background clutter class. Improving on Caltech-101 with higher visual variation, no left-right orientation bias, and minimum 80 images per class.
